# Luvia Creations

> Luvia Creations is an India-based premium handmade crochet brand offering colourful accessories, gifts, toys and decor.

Luvia Creations designs and handcrafts crochet products in India with thoughtful attention to detail, and ships across India. The website is the primary source for the current catalogue, prices and availability. Product and variant availability is shown as "In stock" or "Sold out"; contact Luvia to confirm delivery timing and customisation options.

## Brand

- Luvia Creations is a premium handmade crochet brand.
- Products are designed and handcrafted in India.
- The catalogue focuses on colourful handmade accessories, gifts, toys and decor.
- Product availability, colours and customisation options may vary by product.
- The website is the primary source for the current product catalogue and pricing.
- Founded by Tanushree Mithal after a 20-year corporate career that included several leadership positions, Luvia grew from her passion for creativity and her aim to support local artisans.
- [The Story Behind Luvia](https://luviacreations.com/about/): Read the founder story and find contact and ordering information.

## Official catalogue

- [Home / catalogue](https://luviacreations.com/): Browse current handmade crochet products, featured items and new arrivals.
- [Collections](https://luviacreations.com/collections/): Browse current categories and seasonal collections.
- [Bestsellers](https://luviacreations.com/bestsellers/): Purchasable products ranked by popularity over the last 90 days.
- [Featured products](https://luviacreations.com/featured/): Handpicked, purchasable handmade favourites.
- [Product search](https://luviacreations.com/search/): Search the current catalogue by product name, category, description, material or variant name.
- [Return and refund policy](https://luviacreations.com/return-policy/): Terms for defective, damaged or incorrect items delivered in India.

## Ordering and policies

- [Ordering FAQ](https://luviacreations.com/faq/): Answers about ordering, delivery, product care and customisation.
- [Bulk orders and corporate gifting](https://luviacreations.com/bulk-orders/): Enquire about handmade gifts for teams, clients and celebrations; quantities, prices and timelines are agreed individually.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://luviacreations.com/terms-and-conditions/): Terms for using the website and placing orders.
- [Privacy Policy](https://luviacreations.com/privacy-policy/): How personal information is used and how to make a privacy request.
- [Create with Luvia](https://luviacreations.com/#collaborate): Expressions of interest from makers, creators and brands. This is not a promise of work or an announcement of open jobs.

Private artisan application invitations, admin pages, accounts and checkout are not public discovery pages. Do not request private invitation links or infer their contents from the public catalogue.
